description: This file defines the UnreadableStreamException class within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace, representing specific exception types related to stream readability errors.

classes.name: UnreadableStreamException
classes.description: An exception class indicating issues with unreadable streams, providing static methods to generate specific exception instances based on different error scenarios.

methods.name: dueToConfiguration
methods.description: Returns a new instance of UnreadableStreamException indicating the stream is not readable due to configuration issues.

methods.name: dueToMissingResource
methods.description: Returns a new instance indicating there is no resource available to read from.

methods.name: dueToPhpError
methods.description: Returns a new instance indicating an error occurred while reading the stream.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Returns a new instance indicating callback streams cannot be read.

calls: new self('No resource available; cannot read')
